item.title: CONFIRMED: HATATE, ADAMU START, OX ON STAND-BY
item.description: MARTIN O’NEILL has brought in Junior Adamu to lead the Celtic frontline against Kilmarnock in the 2pm kick-off at Rugby Park today. Tomas Cvancara drops to the substitutes’ bench alongside Alex Oxlade-Chamberlain, the midweek match winner against Livingston. item.title: O’NEILL JOY OVERLOAD AS HEARTS LOSE
item.description: MARTIN O’NEILL celebrated his 300th game in charge of Celtic by witnessing yet another extraordinary comeback in the 3-2 victory over Kilmarnock at Rugby Park this afternoon. The 73-year-old gaffer winced as the champions trailed 2-0 at the interval against Neil McCann’s rejuvenated side.
